title: THE PAD WALK SKIPS KEYS WITH NOTHING ON THEM
why: His order of 2026-10-13 (redo the bar at the bottom), build 7 of 8. On a controller the bumpers walk the belt, and the walk already stepped over a vacant gun key. It now also steps over a throwable, medical or armour key that has nothing of its kind on it, so RB and LB land only on keys that hold something. A key he bound that has run out (greyed at 0) is still a key to land on.
now: The controller bumpers now walk the belt over keys with nothing on them.

edits.replacement: for(k=0;k<n;k++){ i=(i+dir+n)%n; if(!(sl[i]&&(sl[i].vacant||sl[i].kind==='empty'))) break; }   // v25.xx (belt7): and a key with nothing on it (a throwable, medical or armour key with none of its kind)
